decisionScope: Real-device and real-person accuracy are explicitly Future Work, not false passes. Only unresolved model redistribution/licensing conditions still block release; Cloudflare Preview CSP verified, production site integration still separate.

gates.subject: Authoritative license/redistribution permission for exact EfficientDet-Lite0 int8 .tflite
gates.observation: Exact 4,602,795-byte int8 model matches pinned SHA-256, ModelMetadata.author is MediaPipe, ModelMetadata.license is empty, GCS object has no license headers. Official use/download docs do not explicitly grant standalone HTML redistribution.

gates.subject: Confirm license/NOTICE copy distribution alongside the independent single HTML
gates.observation: Full MediaPipe Apache-2.0 license text is embedded visibly within the standalone Help dialog by the build. Review whether the pinned compiled JS/WASM and the standalone HTML also require additional LICENSE/NOTICE texts; the separate model is not covered by this code license.

gates.subject: Cloudflare live preview HTTP CSP headers and final production header compatibility
gates.observation: Cloudflare PR #10 Preview HTTP 200 served v1.0.0 without HTTP CSP header but with inline meta CSP; Chrome actually initialized the embedded model to ready with zero CSP violations, JavaScript errors and external HTTP requests. GitHub Pages HTTP 200 served a different v1.1.0; verify its deployment separately.

notes: User requested that physical-device tests and real crossing precision/recall become Future Work, with the actual limitations disclosed rather than marked passed.
CSP-HOST verification is scoped to the actually deployed Cloudflare PR #10 Preview of v1.0.0; it does not assert an untested Browser Kitty main-site deployment.
GitHub Pages was seen serving v1.1.0 at audit time; the version differs from the PR and must not be confused with the verified v1.0.0 preview.
The exact model metadata contains no license text; model.config.json has been changed to UNVERIFIED rather than making an unsupported Apache-2.0 claim.
Version 1.0.0 in source and downloadable build identifies the requested candidate, not a validated stable release.
The Web Serial Terminal-style help layout and background scroll locking, including Escape, X, backdrop and mobile short-height operation, are subject to automated testing.
The PDF Organizer README structure is a documentation reference only; no PDF-specific capability is attributed to Passage Counter.
v0.10.0 is a pre-release camera-first UX and A/B line interaction improvement; its CI is not a substitute for physical devices or field accuracy.
The line centre translates both endpoints together, preserving length and angle; each endpoint adjusts independently.
An empty region of the camera should remain scrollable on mobile; line and handle gestures use isolated touch hit regions.
A successful GitHub Actions run proves the listed automatic checks, not field accuracy.
The three-event synthetic scoring example must never count as human-labeled field evidence.
The repo's model.config.json license declaration alone does not establish a model-specific redistribution grant.
